## Summary

Describe the purpose of this change and the user-facing result.

## Change type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Refactoring

## Validation

- [ ] `npm ci`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -- --check`
- [ ] `cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings`
- [ ] `cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml`
- [ ] I manually tested the affected workflow in the desktop application.

## Security and privacy

- [ ] No secret, token, personal data, or confidential document is included.
- [ ] File-system permission changes are documented and limited to what is required.
